priorityList: Cast Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation, Trinkets, Racials, and Potions.
Use Soul Reaper (if Pestilence is talented, time it 5 seconds before Dark Transformation ends; otherwise use immediately if Reaping is active).
Cast Army of the Dead on pull or when available.
Cast Dark Transformation on cooldown to trigger Gift of the San'layn.
Cast Abomination Limb to generate Runic Power and damage.
Cast Apocalypse if the target has 4 or more Festering Wounds.
Cast Vampiric Strike while the Gift of the San'layn buff is active.
Cast Vampiric Strike while the Essence of the Blood Queen buff is active.
Cast Death Coil if a Sudden Doom proc is active.
Cast Vampiric Strike to consume Infliction of Sorrow for burst damage.
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 Festering Wounds or need to reach 4 for Apocalypse.
Cast Scourge Strike (or Clawing Shadows) to consume Festering Wounds when Vampiric Strike is unavailable.
Cast Death Coil to spend Runic Power and avoid capping.
Cast Death Coil to reduce the remaining cooldown on Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation.
